ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Reservation_Status__c), "Checked-Out"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Reservation_Status__c), "Cancelled")), OR(ISCHANGED(Room__c), ISCHANGED(Guest__c), ISCHANGED(Check_In_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Check_Out_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Number_of_Guests__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Checked-Out and Cancelled reservations are history: room, guest, dates and guest count cannot be changed.
